workedExamples.prompt: Divide “rabbit” using the taught VCCV pattern.
workedExamples.solution: Rabbit can be divided rab-bit; read each syllable and blend the complete word.

workedExamples.prompt: A learner guesses “picnic” without checking both parts. What should be done?
workedExamples.solution: Divide picnic into pic-nic, read each part, then blend and check meaning.

workedExamples.prompt: Why try a fresh example after guided practice?
workedExamples.solution: A new item checks independent use of the syllable pattern.
